name: Guatemala
about: Dry season (Nov–Apr) is best for both; volcano hikes near Antigua (Acatenango, Pacaya) are a signature draw year-round.
overview: Colonial Antigua and Lake Atitlán sit high in volcanic highlands, cool and spring-like most of the year — a contrast to Tikal's hot, humid jungle ruins up north.
costOverview: One of the cheapest destinations in this list — a real plate of pepián, the national dish, costs just a few dollars, and even a coffee plantation tour stays affordable.

specialSeasons.text: Semana Santa (Holy Week) in Antigua brings elaborate flower-carpet processions — one of the most striking Easter celebrations in the Americas.
Tikal's jungle canopy is greener and wildlife more active, though trails around Antigua's volcanoes get muddier.
